author: श्रीराघवेन्द्रस्वामी
commentary: इन्द्रियेषु प्रवर्तकत्वेन स्थितस्य हरेरिन्द्रियद्वारा विषयभोगमाह ॥ श्रोत्रमिति । अधिष्ठायैवेत्यन्वयः । प्रवर्तकः सन्नेवेत्यर्थः । विषयान् शब्दादीन् ॥ १५.९॥
translation:
The Lord having taken His stand in the ear, in the eye, in the touch, in the taste, in the smell, and also in the mind, enjoys the objects of the senses. (9.)
V. The particle Eva is to be constructed with the past participle. The force of it is, " standing as the guide." (9.)
A. If it be asked whether the Lord partakes of the inauspicious or undesirable experience of the senses, it is denied; for He enjoys only what is blissful. Then how is it that He. is not perceived as such? To clear this question Sri Krishna says:
